final_selected_items_raw.source_sentence: On July 14, after the withdrawal and replacement announcement, Brent crude futures briefly gave back some of their gains
Reuters linked that rise to concern about a US sea blockade of Iran, planned for the next day, and energy shipments through the Strait of Hormuz
On July 14, after the withdrawal and replacement announcement, Brent crude futures briefly gave back some of their gains
For the moment, only a large number stood at center stage

Concerns about US-Iran attacks, the sea blockade, and tanker safety continued on July 14, so the flashy 20% plan left the stage, but the chart only pulled back briefly before recovering: the policy turn and the oil chart's "not over yet" movement happened on the same day
